title: Mercy that makes courage possible
subtitle: For the heart leaving hardness and self-protection
description: These readings show mercy not as softness alone, but as the force that lets the heart stop living behind armor.

heroSource.shortMeaning: Received mercy can make forgiveness fearless because the self no longer has to defend every wound alone.
heroSource.lifeApplication: Let mercy lower one defense before fear turns it into hardness.

evidence.coreClaim: This path links mercy and fearlessness where self-protection has become a habit.
evidence.turn: Courage appears when mercy becomes more trustworthy than armor.
evidence.practicalImplication: Choose one truthful, merciful response where fear would prefer hardness.
